title: Solidarity AI: Platform Cooperativism Conference 2026
description: The Platform Cooperativism Consortium's 2026 conference, co-convened with PCC Thailand at Chulalongkorn University in Bangkok and following its 2025 Istanbul event on cooperatives and AI. It asks who builds, owns, and governs AI, and brings together researchers, co-op leaders and worker-owners, AI developers, labor organizers, feminist, queer, and disability-rights advocates, journalists, and artists. The format mixes invited talks, reverse panels, design clinics, and hands-on workshops, aimed at a collectively written set of "Bangkok Theses" and a shared Solidarity AI glossary. Featured projects include farmer-run data and climate-resilience co-ops in India, Thailand, and Indonesia. Pre-conference sessions on November 10-11 include a day-long Feminist AI workshop by IT for Change. In person; register through the conference page (no fee or online option is stated).
